project.title: MES Acceptance C - Additional Stock Footage
project.description:
Create a 15.6 second narrated montage at EXACTLY 24 fps. Use the supplied narration exactly. Music is explicitly opted out, so the mix is narration only. Honour the supplied locked timeline: 24 fps, the four locked scene boundaries, and the 0.5s crossfade.

This production exists to exercise ADDITIONAL STOCK FOOTAGE acquisition through the Pexels provider. Therefore:

- Every gap scene MUST be filled with real MOTION VIDEO downloaded from Pexels using the `pexels_video` tool, which performs a real Pexels API request with PEXELS_API_KEY from the environment. Do not read, print, log, or copy the key's value anywhere.
- Do NOT use Archive.org, NASA, Wikimedia Commons, Pixabay, Unsplash, still images, generated video, colour cards, or fixture media. Pexels motion video only.
- `artifacts/asset_manifest.json` MUST record, for every acquired clip: the provider (`pexels`), the real Pexels video id, the original Pexels page/download URL, the photographer/author attribution, the licence (Pexels License) and its terms URL, the local relative path, the SHA256, and the ffprobe-confirmed duration/resolution/codec. Every entry must be a real video stream, not an image.
- The assets stage is a real editorial review gate: present the selected clips with their provider, licence and relevance so a human can approve or reject them before the edit proceeds.
- If a Pexels request fails or returns no usable motion clip, fail the stage and report it. Never silently substitute another provider or a still image.

The final MP4 must visibly contain the acquired Pexels footage.

production.style: clean modern documentary; real stock motion footage only
